quest.title: The Culling of the Worms: Gathering
quest.description: After running about, you manage to help Vinayak gather the components...

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Oh... thank you, brave Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Oh, phew! It hasn't been too long and the parts are still in good condition... Just a few more adjustments...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Vinayak starts tinkering with the machinery...

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: ...Vinayak?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Almost done... I'm almost done!

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Vi-na-yak!

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Whoa! Shriya? When did you get here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When you were fiddling with the components...

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Didn't you say that this place was dangerous and full of monsters? Why are you even here?

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: ...I'm just worried about our components. If we can't finish this assignment, even I can't return to the Akademiya!

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Ha, I knew it. Look, I have everything here. Once we go back and make some more adjustments, we can finally start assembling.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what are all these components for?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Ah, I forgot to tell you. They're for the Wenutslayer Cannon, our graduation project.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why such an obscure topic?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: If you'd applied for graduation, you'd understand why... Well, not that any of this matters now.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Allow me to formally introduce myself. I am Shriya, an Amurta graduate with a specialization in desert biology and ecology.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: This machine-obsessed doofus over here is a Kshahrewar researcher with a specialization in applied mechanics.

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: ...I'm Vinayak. Thanks a lot for earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can people with completely different fields of study... work together?

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Don't get me started... Working with him on our graduation proposal was definitely the biggest mistake I've ever made as a student...

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: You can't really say that. We both managed to graduate in the end anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: We did, yes, but did you forget how many extra years it took?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, we graduated, right? I heard some of our classmates just completed their thesis proposal last year.

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Ugh... enough! We're not students anymore, so can we just move on from these pointless discussions?

dialogues.speaker: Vinayak
dialogues.text: You're the one who always starts it...

dialogues.speaker: Shriya
dialogues.text: Nonsense! When we were building the first prototype...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... you guys have it out for each other. How could the Akademiya even think of sending you two together to handle this...

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: *sigh* Actually, the Akademiya didn't send us... A person named Kunar was supposed to take care of this matter.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: You could call him my mentor's mentor... He was there during our thesis defense.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: I guess that was how he got the impression that "some young students in the Akademiya had designed a Wenutslayer Cannon," or something like that.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: So this time, he simply kicked the two of us back here to deal with the problem, saying that "the Akademiya needs to give youngsters more opportunities to shine!"

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: But he obviously didn't consider the fact that the two of us have barely talked to each other since graduation...

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: He even convinced my mentor... Ahem, anyway, this is an opportunity for me to get the Wenutslayer Cannon back out in the open!

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: Once it's assembled, we'll show those vermin what it can do!

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: There that mechanical idiot goes again... From my point of view, I also want to investigate the cause of the Wenut rampage to maintain the ecological balance of the desert.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} Adventurer, you look like someone of impressive skill. May I ask you to keep us safe while we're in the desert?

choices.text: I'll do it for the right price.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: Rest assured. There isn't a lot of support from the Akademiya, but at least we're well-funded. ...Although someone here has spent most of it on upgrading the machinery.

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: Th—The improvements were necessary! ...And since you're capable of speaking politely, can't you be a little nicer to me?

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: That depends on whether the person I'm talking to is worthy of my patience!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no... here they go again...

choices.text: Maybe leave the arguing for later?

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: *sigh* Sorry... It's an old habit from my Akademiya days...

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: This batch of components has to be brought back to Aaru Village for further adjustment. By all accounts, we can't start assembling until tomorrow.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: We had previously planned to install the Wenutslayer Cannon in nearby areas where Wenut have been spotted.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: When the time comes, there may be other creatures attracted by the noise we make. We'll be counting on you.

response.speaker: Vinayak
response.text: We can continue our debate now, right? I'm telling you, all my expenses are justified.

response.speaker: Shriya
response.text: You...! Fine, you asked for it. Let's go over the details and see where all that Mora went!

choices.text: Can we start with the actual work?
It'll be a walk in a park for me.
Arguing isn't gonna get you anywhere.
